description: Adding an override after the snapshot is a miss: the state is the real refresh with lib read from the lib directory; the read now names a sources manifest declaring lib as that same directory and overriding it with lib-local, whose part.kdl is byte-identical but whose notes.txt differs, so the tree the reading reads has another identity; its one record line was edited after the refresh to hold locale nb-no where the reading binds sv-se (the payload digest restamped), so a restore prints nb-no and a replay prints sv-se.
